title: Transcending water boundaries
content:
Abstract
In this essay, I recreate my academic journey through aquatic ecosystems, including historical events in limnological and marine science research in Chile. I share my career, my deep commitment, opportunities, projects, lessons, including the progress of women scientists in Latin America raising their voices, noting advances in scientific knowledge, education, training, and outreach. Some recommendations I can pass to others as I learned to love nature are, to do as much as you can, to persist and persevere in (sharing) the joy of wonder related to living with the ocean and caring for the Sea.
